name: APIVerveJSONtoJSONP
summary: JSON to JSONP wraps JSON data in a JavaScript callback function to produce valid JSONP output.
description:
JSON to JSONP wraps JSON data in a JavaScript callback function to produce valid JSONP output. Pass an object or JSON string with an optional callback identifier to receive the formatted script string.

This iOS/macOS SDK provides a convenient way to access the JSON to JSONP from APIVerve.
Supports both callback-based and async/await patterns.
